tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_tidehunter_kraken_s:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.
Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.
Does not stack with items that provide Damage Block.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_tidehunter_bio: The Tidehunter known as Leviathan was once the champion of the Sunken Isles, but his motives are as mysterious as those of his people. We all know the importance of the Drylanders' shipping lanes, how empires may rise and fall according to who controls the open water. Far less is known of the submarine lanes, and how the warring tribes of the Meranthic Diaspora have carved out habitations through endless undersea skirmishes. In the fragile treaties between the Mer and Men, we can glimpse the extent of the drowned empires, but their politics appear complex and opaque. It would seem that Leviathan tired of such petty strife, and set off on his own, loyal only to his abyssal god, Maelrawn the Tentacular. He stalks the shallows now in search of men or meranths who stray into his path, and with a particular loathing for Admiral Kunkka, who has long been his nemesis for reasons lost in the deepest trenches of the sea.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_tidehunter_hype: Stalking ahead of his team, Tidehunter is always on the lookout for the right time to strike. When the moment comes, he unleashes his massive and devastating ultimate, paving the way for his allies to slay their stunned enemies.

Far less is known of the submarine lanes, and how the warring tribes of the Meranthic Diaspora have carved out habitations through endless undersea skirmishes. In the fragile treaties between the Mer and Men, we can glimpse the extent of the drowned empires, but their politics appear complex and opaque. It would seem that Leviathan tired of such petty strife, and set off on his own, loyal only to his abyssal god, Maelrawn the Tentacular. He stalks the shallows now in search of men or meranths who stray into his path, and with a particular loathing for Admiral Kunkka, who has long been his nemesis for reasons lost in the deepest trenches of the sea.

npc_dota_hero_tidehunter_hype.raw: Stalking ahead of his team, Tidehunter is always on the lookout for the right time to strike. When the moment comes, he unleashes his massive and devastating ultimate, paving the way for his allies to slay their stunned enemies.

qualifications.raw: [[Roshan]] is innately immune to all Anchor Smash ability effects.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|tidehunter_anchor_smash}}
*#* Reduces {{M|main attack damage}} of affected enemy units within the radius.
*#* Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration.
*# {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
*#* Applies the [[instant attack]] within the radius procs any {{M|attack modifiers}} and {{M|on-cast effects}} as per normal, except the following sources:
*#** {{M|Cleave}} sources.
*#* Have {{M|True Strike}}.
*#* Not affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
*#* The instant attack damage is defined as:
*#** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|InstantAtk {{=}} Σ[[Attack Damage|AtkDmg]] + {{#var:Anchor Smash value4}}}}
*#* Affects the following units:
*#** {{M|Ancient creeps}}.
*#** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*#** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*#* Does not affect the following units:
*#** {{M|Buildings}}
*#*** {{cf|talnotes}} This restriction is removed upon learning the {{M|talent|t=t4l}}.
*#** {{M|Couriers}}
*#** {{M|Spell immune}} units.
*#** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
*#** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

{{Spellunit
| name = Anchor
| desc0 = The Anchor is always created {{#var:Dead in the Water basic2}}-distance next to Tidehunter, and travels to the unit-targeted enemy unit.

| icon1 = Tower Factor
| type1 = alticon
| target1 = Passive
| desc1 = Towers do not attack the Anchor.

| icon2 = Phased wikiasset
| type2 = alticon
| target2 = Passive
| desc2 = {{Show|A|Anchor|Phase Movement|desc0}}

| icon3 = Spell Immunity
| type3 = alticon
| target3 = Passive
| desc3 = {{Show|A|Anchor|Spell Immunity|desc0}}}}

* Acquiring {{M|Aghanim's Shard}} unlocks this ability in the {{Spellslot|4|5}}.

* The ability has the following additional properties:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*** Consider enemy {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
*** {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}}
**** When exceeding {{Code|< {{#var:Dead in the Water cast range}}}} [[cast range]], the Anchor stops traveling when it is {{#var:Dead in the Water value1}}-distance next to the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Anchor}}
*** Has the following unit additional properties: 
**** Has {{M|unobstructed movement}}.
**** Blocks spawn of {{M|neutral creep}} camps.
**** Not affected by {{M|upward movement}} sources applied to the affected enemy unit.
**** {{M|Teleports}} along with the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
*# {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|tidehunter_dead_in_the_water}}
*#* Applies the following ability effects on the affected enemy unit upon [[projectile]] impact:
*#** {{M|Expose}}
*#** Grants {{M|True Sight}} over it.
*#** {{Symbol|Leash}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Anchor}}
*#*** The debuff-affected enemy unit is now [[leashed]] to the {{U|Anchor}}.
*#*** The distance between the enemy and the Anchor cannot exceed {{Code|< {{#var:Dead in the Water value1}}}}.
*#*** Sets the enemy's {{M|movement speed}} to a max value when it attempts to move {{Code|< {{#var:Dead in the Water value1}}}} while {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|tidehunter_dead_in_the_water}} is active. The Anchor now moves along with the enemy unit.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Passively damage block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Kraken Shell is less effective against creeps.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Temporarily hardens Tidehunter's hide further, reducing even more physical attack damage with a trade-off.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: Tidehunter's hide also removes negative status effects if the player-based damage taken crosses a threshold.

fields.name: desc4
fields.value: Passively applies Anchor Smash of its corresponding level upon a Kraken Shell self-dispel procs.

fields.name: buff2text
fields.value: Kraken Shell: Blocking more damage. Losing x% movespeed.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* This ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Damage Block}}
*** Kraken Shell is an ensured [[damage block]] source.
*** Sources with lesser damage block values have no effect if they proc as the higher factor takes precedence.
**** Hence, the {{A|Damage Block|Damage Block (Melee)}} {{M|innate}} ability is no longer functional upon learning this ability.
*** Does not interact with the following damage sources:
**** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} [[Attack Damage#Set Attack Damage|Set]] attack damage sources.
**** {{M|Physical}} {{M|spell damage}}, except from the [[Damage Block#Blocked Spell Damage|these]] sources.
**** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] 
*** The {{M|strong dispel}} component is applied as follows:
***# The ability or damage instance that procs the dispel component per damage threshold accumulated ([[Damage Manipulation|after all reductions]]).
***#* {{Symbol|a|Counter}}
***#** The damage threshold counter resets when Tidehunter does not take player-based damage for the last {{#var:Blubber value2}} seconds.
***#* Only accumulates {{Code|≥ 0-damage instance}} from heroes and {{M|summons|text=player-controlled units}} regardless of {{M|factions}}.
***#* Hence, the ability still considers a {{Code|0-damage instance}} as a valid damage instance, and does not cause the damage threshold counter to reset.
***# All debuffs are dispelled before the debuff can be applied.
***# {{cf|talnotes}} Applies {{A|Tidehunter|Anchor Smash}} of its corresponding level.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_tidehunter
data.bio_loc: The Tidehunter known as Leviathan was once the champion of the Sunken Isles, but his motives are as mysterious as those of his people. We all know the importance of the Drylanders' shipping lanes, how empires may rise and fall according to who controls the open water. Far less is known of the submarine lanes, and how the warring tribes of the Meranthic Diaspora have carved out habitations through endless undersea skirmishes. In the fragile treaties between the Mer and Men, we can glimpse the extent of the drowned empires, but their politics appear complex and opaque. It would seem that Leviathan tired of such petty strife, and set off on his own, loyal only to his abyssal god, Maelrawn the Tentacular. He stalks the shallows now in search of men or meranths who stray into his path, and with a particular loathing for Admiral Kunkka, who has long been his nemesis for reasons lost in the deepest trenches of the sea.
data.hype_loc: Stalking ahead of his team, Tidehunter is always on the lookout for the right time to strike. When the moment comes, he unleashes his massive and devastating ultimate, paving the way for his allies to slay their stunned enemies.
data.npe_desc_loc: Durable hero who shrugs off enemy damage

abilities.name: tidehunter_gush
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
abilities.lore_loc: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.
abilities.scepter_loc: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.

abilities.name: tidehunter_kraken_shell
abilities.desc_loc:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.
facets_loc: Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.

abilities.name: tidehunter_anchor_smash
abilities.desc_loc: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
abilities.lore_loc: Stolen from one of Admiral Kunkka's flagships, Leviathan's heavy anchor proves useful as a melee weapon.
notes_loc: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water
abilities.desc_loc: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.

abilities.name: tidehunter_ravage
abilities.desc_loc: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
abilities.lore_loc: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.
notes_loc: Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.

abilities.name: tidehunter_leviathans_catch
abilities.desc_loc:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
notes_loc: Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_tidehunter_smash_on_blubber
talents.name_loc: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash
talents.desc_loc: Triggered attack has {s:bonus_smash_on_purge}% damage and is reflected damage.
